name: My Collection Miko
original_name: マイ コレクション 巫女
source:
Beautiful mother and daughter serve as shrine maidens. Main character observes them, grasps their weaknesses and then mercilessly insults both of them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
美丽的母女担任巫女。主角观察他们，抓住他们的弱点，然后无情地侮辱他们。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
